## Modules

- [Gemini.APIs.Batches](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Batches.md): Batches API for batch processing of content generation and embedding requests.
- [Gemini.APIs.ContextCache](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.ContextCache.md): Context caching API for improved performance with long context.
- [Gemini.APIs.Documents](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Documents.md): Documents API for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) document management.
- [Gemini.APIs.FileSearchStores](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.FileSearchStores.md): File Search Stores API for semantic search and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
- [Gemini.APIs.Files](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Files.md): Files API for uploading, managing, and using files with Gemini models.
- [Gemini.APIs.Images](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Images.md): API for image generation using Google's Imagen models.
- [Gemini.APIs.Interactions](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Interactions.md): Interactions API (experimental).
- [Gemini.APIs.Models](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Models.md): Complete Models API implementation following the unified architecture.
- [Gemini.APIs.Operations](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Operations.md): Operations API for managing long-running operations.
- [Gemini.APIs.RagStores](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.RagStores.md): RAG Stores API for managing file search stores.
- [Gemini.APIs.Tokens](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Tokens.md): Token counting functionality for Gemini API.
- [Gemini.APIs.Tunings](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Tunings.md): API module for model tuning (fine-tuning) operations.
- [Gemini.APIs.Videos](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.APIs.Videos.md): API for video generation using Google's Veo models.
- [Gemini.Auth.ADC](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.ADC.md): Application Default Credentials (ADC) for Google Cloud authentication.
- [Gemini.Auth.JWT](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.JWT.md): JWT token generation and management for Google Cloud service accounts.
- [Gemini.Auth.MetadataServer](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.MetadataServer.md): Authentication via GCP metadata server for workloads running on Google Cloud Platform.
- [Gemini.Auth.Strategy](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.Strategy.md): Behavior for authentication strategies.

- [Gemini.Auth.TokenCache](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.TokenCache.md): ETS-based token caching with automatic expiration handling.
- [Gemini.Chat](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Chat.md): Formalized chat session management with immutable history updates.
- [Gemini.GovernedAuthority](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.GovernedAuthority.md): Authority-materialized Gemini inputs for governed execution.
- [Gemini.Live.Models](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Live.Models.md): Live API model selection helpers.
- [Gemini.ModelRegistry](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.ModelRegistry.md): Canonical model registry with capability metadata.
- [Gemini.RateLimiter](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.RateLimiter.md): Rate limiting, concurrency gating, and retry management for Gemini API requests.
- [Gemini.RateLimiter.ConcurrencyGate](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.RateLimiter.ConcurrencyGate.md): Per-model concurrency gating using semaphore-like permits.
- [Gemini.RateLimiter.Config](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.RateLimiter.Config.md): Configuration management for the rate limiter.
- [Gemini.RateLimiter.Manager](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.RateLimiter.Manager.md): Central rate limiter manager that coordinates request submission.
- [Gemini.RateLimiter.RetryManager](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.RateLimiter.RetryManager.md): Manages retry logic with backoff strategies.
- [Gemini.RateLimiter.State](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.RateLimiter.State.md): ETS-based state management for rate limiting.
- [Gemini.Streaming.ToolOrchestrator](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Streaming.ToolOrchestrator.md): GenServer responsible for managing a single, stateful, automatic tool-calling stream.
- [Gemini.Supervisor](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Supervisor.md): Top-level supervisor for the Gemini application.
- [Gemini.TaskSupervisor](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.TaskSupervisor.md): Named task supervisor for Gemini background tasks.

- [Gemini.Tools](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Tools.md): High-level facade for tool registration and execution in the Gemini client.
- [Gemini.Tools.AutomaticFunctionCalling](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Tools.AutomaticFunctionCalling.md): Implements the Automatic Function Calling (AFC) loop for Gemini.
- [Gemini.Tools.AutomaticFunctionCalling.Config](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Tools.AutomaticFunctionCalling.Config.md): Configuration for automatic function calling.

- [Gemini.Tools.Executor](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Tools.Executor.md): Executes function calls from Gemini API responses against a registry of implementations.
- [Gemini.Types.BatchJob](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Types.BatchJob.md): Type definitions for batch processing jobs.
- [Gemini.Types.Blob](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Types.Blob.md): Binary data with MIME type for Gemini API.

- [Gemini.Types.CachedContentUsageMetadata](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Types.CachedContentUsageMetadata.md): Metadata describing cached content usage.

- [Gemini.Types.DeleteFileResponse](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Types.DeleteFileResponse.md): Response type for file deletion.

  - [Gemini.Auth.GeminiStrategy](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.GeminiStrategy.md): Authentication strategy for Google Gemini API using API key.

  - [Gemini.Auth.VertexStrategy](https://gemini-ex.hexdocs.pm/Gemini.Auth.VertexStrategy.md): Authentication strategy for Google Vertex AI using OAuth2/Service Account.
